messages:
zoe: Incoming external pen test next week. Quick list we need: explicit retest gates, who signs the verification, ephemeral RBAC pattern, KMS grant handling, and exact evidence packaging steps. Keep it lean.

al: For retest gates I propose: 1) fix merged to main and deployed to canary 2) smoke tests pass 3) no repro in logs for 48h 4) KMS audit shows only expected activity during the window 5) written vendor sign-off. Who certifies?

matt: I can be the certifier for this engagement; risha backup. Also suggest adding a requirement that vendor include correlation ids in their repro steps so we can map to CloudTrail events.

risha: RBAC pattern: no long-lived cross-account roles. We'll create a per-engagement S3 prefix and mint temporary STS creds with a policy limited to that prefix plus cloudtrail:LookupEvents on the audit account. Example minimal policy snippet I'll add to the playbook: 

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-{{ENG}}/*"] },
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["cloudtrail:LookupEvents"], "Resource": ["*"] }
  ]
}
```

zoe: KMS handling: do not rotate the master key. Instead, create a grant scoped to use with an EncryptionContext tag (engagement id) and revoke after the window. Log grant id and include it in the evidence manifest.

audit-bot: Note: CloudTrail -> Humio forwarding active; kms events included. Default retention: 120d hot / 400d cold. To request different retention open INF-LOGS ticket.

al: Evidence packaging: produce a tarball with cloudtrail-export (last 72h), kube-audit logs for in-scope namespaces, app worker logs (48h), metrics snapshot, and a manifest file with sha256 checksums. GPG-sign the manifest with ops@redwood. Include a small README with verification steps.

matt: Example commands for the playbook I'll add: 

```bash
# create presigned URL for 24h
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-{{ENG}}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
# checksum and sign
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
gpg --local-user ops@redwood --output bundle.sig --detach-sign bundle.sha256
# revoke KMS grant after engagement
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "${GRANT_ID}"
```

risha: Verification checklist on the triage card should include: repro steps, vendor-provided correlation ids, PR link, deployment link, smoke test results, attached logs + sha256s, KMS grant id and CloudTrail event ids. Matt to create the triage board.

zoe: Ops caveat: enforce a 6h RBAC-change freeze during active testing. Any emergency exception must be approved in the triage ticket and logged with rationale and JIRA link.

al: Dry-run proposed: Thu 08:30 UTC. Simulate a P1: create bundle, mint grant, vendor pulls, revoke, then run rollback drill. Everyone ok to join?

matt: I'll run the rollback walkthrough and spin up the triage board template.

risha: I'll publish the playbook with example jq filters to extract CloudTrail events by correlation id. Small sample: 

```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=${CORR_ID} | jq -r '.Events[] | [.EventId, .EventName, .EventTime] | @tsv'
```

zoe: Action items recap: matt=triage board + rollback walkthrough, risha=playbook + RBAC policy + jq filters, al=contract language update for 72h P1 + notification cadence, ops-bot=confirm Humio forwarding & retention. Dry-run Thu 08:30 UTC. Keep edits in this thread. :lock:
